Candidate pages were EBSCO search/result metadata, Silesian University publication and seminar pages, related Li-Yorke sensitivity articles, the Akin-Kolyada problem PDF, Cambridge/AMS later papers, ResearchGate records, or unrelated works. The Akin-Kolyada PDF was rejected because it is a related source containing similar open questions, not the exact Ciklova Real Analysis Exchange article identified by the zbMATH record. No readable exact-work PDF or HTML source containing the article body/problem statements was recovered.
